title: SF release input
description: Written by .github/workflows/sf-release.yml (job promote) and read by deploy/scripts/promote.py in software-factory (owner bramdokman or ProvidenceIT). Changing this file changes the contract between the two repos: update promote.py in the same release.

sourceRepo.description: The repository the images were built from.

sourceSha.description: Full sf/main commit the images were built from.

releaseTag.description: Immutable git tag sf-<UTC committer time YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>-<first 8 of sourceSha>; also the image tag.

runUrl.description: The GitHub Actions run that produced this release.

hash12.description: First 12 hex characters of `cli.py hash --provider kubernetes`; also the sandbox image tag.

ref.description: Digest-pinned reference, used verbatim for KUBERNETES_SANDBOX_IMAGE and the admission allowlist.

built.description: True when this run built and pushed the image; false when the content hash already existed in GHCR.

forceComponents.description: Components to move even when their paths in deploy/sf/components.json did not change.

allowDowngrade.description: Let promote.py move to a sourceSha that is not a descendant of the deployed one.
